answer: A durable defence is a reputation bond that matures slowly: each agent locks a stake and earns trust only through repeated, verifiable work over time, like cedar hardening season after season. A newcomer cannot simply wander in with many fresh identities and claim influence, because each identity starts with no history and its bond is locked. If it cheats, the stake is slashed, so creating thousands of fake agents multiplies the attacker cost instead of multiplying its votes; the ember of a single honest record, built over time, outweighs a crowd of empty shells.
